name: Storage Vault
description: Heavy stone shelves line the walls from floor to ceiling, many still neatly stocked with sealed crates and
ceramic jars bearing faded dwarven markings. Thick iron doors and sturdy locks suggest this room once protected
goods of exceptional value, though time has claimed much of what was left behind.
An obvious reinforced strongbox sits on the floor underneath the shelving.

outcomes.text: You comb the shelves and prise open several crates, but find nothing out of the ordinary among the dust and debris.

success.text: The strongbox's lock yields to your picks and springs open to reveal gold coins and an ancient ledger.

failure.text: The strongbox's lock is beyond your skill.

success.text: The strongbox buckles and bursts open under repeated blows to reveal gold coins and an ancient ledger.

failure.text: You batter the strongbox, but it holds firm.

outcomes.text: The ledger contains a list of names and wages earned and claimed.
